_about: Test save data, in the app's own export format (lib/storage.js exportProgress). A returning learner partway through hiragana who has already been through the first-visit welcome. It deliberately holds NO grammar, kanji or vocabulary progress: the render tests set those per case, and a greeting or word-list branch must not be decided by this file. Loaded by test/load-save.mjs, which refuses it if the format drifts.
